Our Roofing Services

New Roofs and Re-Roofs

Full installs and replacements in tile and slate, for tired old roofs, extensions and new builds.

Flat Roofs

EPDM rubber, GRP fibreglass, felt and single-ply for dormers, extensions and garages.

Roof Repairs and Leaks

Leaks traced and fixed, slipped and missing tiles replaced, storm damage made safe.

Chimney Repairs

How We Work

Why Choose Vanguard Roofing Solutions

When you call, you deal with the person who does the work. We look at the roof properly, tell you in plain English whether it needs a repair or a replacement, and give you a straight price.

  • Straight, Written Quotes

    No-obligation prices based on what the job needs, and if something unexpected turns up we tell you before we do anything.

  • Quick to Respond

    Customers mention John coming round the same day for a leak, and booking the fix for the next.

  • Rated 4.9 on Google

    46 reviews from homeowners across Kent and South London, several of them coming back for a second job.

  • You Deal With John

    No call centre. The person who prices the job is on the roof, keeping you updated as it goes.

  • Local to Sevenoaks

    Based in Sevenoaks and working from Croydon and Bromley across to Bexley and Dartford.

About Us

The Team Behind Vanguard Roofing Solutions

Vanguard Roofing Solutions is run by John Quilligan from Sevenoaks, with a small team that takes on everything from a single slipped tile to a full re-roof across Kent and South London.

It was my dad's business. I took over and turned it into Vanguard Roofing to modernise it. Before that it was John Ryan and Sons Building.

When you get in touch, it is John who comes out, looks at the roof and explains what it needs. Customers mention the same things again and again: he turns up when he says he will, keeps them updated and leaves the place tidy.

John QuilliganDirector, Vanguard Roofing Solutions
